subject: Life Skills
title: Anatomy of a Phishing Email
description: Learn Anatomy of a Phishing Email in one minute.

hook.text: Over 3 billion phishing emails are sent every single day. Some look perfectly legitimate.

buildup.text: Phishers copy logos, formatting, and language from real companies to fool your instincts.

discovery.text: The sender address is the first clue. 'support@amaz0n-help.com' is not Amazon.

twist.text: Urgency is the weapon. 'Your account will be closed in 24 hours' bypasses careful thinking.

climax.text: Never click links in urgent emails. Go directly to the website by typing the address yourself.

punchline.text: If it's urgent and unexpected, it's suspect.

quiz.question: What is the most reliable way to verify a suspicious email?
options: Click the link to check the website
Go to the real site by typing its address
